# observe_escalation_policy (Resource)

Who is paged for an incident, in what order, until someone acknowledges. One per team, plus one for the whole organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "observe_escalation_policy" "default" {
  name         = "Default"
  repeat_times = 2

  steps = [
    { wait_minutes = 5, targets = [{ type = "schedule", id = observe_on_call_schedule.primary.id }] },
    { wait_minutes = 15, targets = [{ type = "channel", id = observe_notification_channel.slack.id }] },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `steps` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider's `organization_id`
- `repeat_times` (Number) Times to start over after the last step
- `team_id` (String) The team whose monitors it covers; null for the rest

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Required:

- `targets` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps--targets))
- `wait_minutes` (Number) Minutes before the next step. One of `1`, `5`, `10`, `15`, `30`, `60`.

<a id="nestedatt--steps--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps.targets`

Required:

- `id` (String) A member (not a viewer), an on-call schedule or a notification channel
- `type` (String) One of `user`, `schedule`, `channel`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization_id>/<id>, or <id> when the provider sets organization_id
terraform import observe_escalation_policy.example 01JCX4ZK7N2Q8V3W5Y6A9B0C1D/01JCX5A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9J0K1
```
